title: Decellularization for the Preparation of Highly Preserved Human Acellular Skin Matrix for Regenerative Medicine
protocol: Prepare 600 mL of 2% Triton X-100 solution.
Measure 588 mL of double-distilled water in a graduated cylinder.
Transfer the measured water to a 1 L beaker.
Add 12 mL of Triton X-100 using a serological pipette.
Place a stir bar in the beaker.
Mix the solution on a magnetic stirrer until Triton X-100 is completely dissolved.
Remove the stir bar using a stir bar retriever.
Store the solution at room temperature.
Prepare 600 mL of 2% SDS solution.
Measure 550 mL of double-distilled water in a graduated cylinder.
Transfer the measured water to a 1 L beaker.
Weigh 12 g of SDS powder and transfer it to the beaker containing the water.
Place a stir bar in the beaker.
Mix the solution on a magnetic stirrer until SDS is completely dissolved.
Remove the stir bar using a stir bar retriever.
Transfer the solution to a graduated cylinder and adjust the volume to 600 mL by adding double-distilled water.
Pour 2% Triton X-100 solution into a 2 L cylinder.
Pour 2% SDS solution into the same 2 L cylinder to obtain a total volume of 1200 mL.
Cover with parafilm and mix gently by inversion to obtain a homogeneous solution.
Transfer the mixed solution to a 2 L bottle using a funnel to avoid the formation of foam.
Store the solution at +4 °C.
Prepare 500 mL of 1x phosphate-buffered-saline (PBS) by dissolving specified amounts in sterile double-distilled water.
Check the pH value and ensure it is 7.4.
Store the PBS solution at +4 °C until use.
Weigh 625 µg of amphotericin B in a plastic weighing boat.
Pipette 8 mL of penicillin and streptomycin mixture into a 15 mL tube.
Add the weighed amphotericin B to the pen/strep mixture.
Adjust the volume to 10 mL by adding more penicillin and streptomycin mixture.
Cap the tube and dissolve the amphotericin B by shaking vigorously.
Pour 400 mL of decellularizing solution into a 500 mL beaker.
Add 2.0 mL of antibiotic solution to the decellularizing solution.
Wash the human skin sample in a plastic tray using a 0.9% NaCl isotonic physiological solution.
Remove excess blood and other biological fluids by shaking and turning the tray upside down.
Use fine forceps to remove hair from the skin sample.
Use large surgical scissors to remove fat from the skin sample.
Place the cleaned skin sample on a dissecting board.
Dissect the skin using a scalpel, obtaining 3 cm x 2.5 cm fragments.
Avoid scars and dirty or burned areas during dissection.
Place each fragment in an embedding cassette.
Close and lock the embedding cassettes to prevent leakage of samples.
Place up to four embedding cassettes with samples into a beaker containing decellularizing solution.
Add a stir bar to the beaker.
Cover the beaker with aluminum foil, writing sample information and starting time on top.
Place the beaker on a magnetic stirrer.
Start agitation at a rotational velocity of 150 rpm.
Stop the agitation after checking the clarity of the solution.
Remove the aluminum foil covering the beaker.
Take out the embedding cassettes using long forceps.
Place each cassette in a 100 mm dish.
Replace the decellularizing solution by repeating steps 3.5-3.6 overnight.
Check the state of the skin samples.
Stop the agitation process.
Remove the aluminum foil covering the beaker.
Take the embedding cassettes out with long forceps.
Open each cassette and check the color of the sample.
Remove residual hair and detach the epidermis from the dermis.
Replace the decellularizing solution by repeating steps 3.5-3.6.
Stop the agitation after 8 hours.
Repeat steps 4.1-4.2 until the sample appears snow-white.
Measure 400 mL of 1x PBS in a 500 mL cylinder.
Pour the measured 1x PBS into a 500 mL beaker.
Add 2 mL of Pen Strep/Amphotericin B mixture to the beaker.
Add a stir bar to the beaker.
Place a maximum of four cassettes containing samples in each beaker with 1x PBS/antibiotics solution.
Cover each beaker with aluminum foil and write information on top as specified in step 3.5.
Place the beakers on a magnetic stirrer.
Start agitation at a rotational velocity of 150 rpm overnight, at room temperature.
Stop the agitation process.
Replace the 1x PBS solution with 400 mL of double-distilled water.
Add a stir bar to each beaker containing samples.
Cover each beaker with aluminum foil and write information on top as specified in step 3.5.
Place the beaker on a magnetic stirrer.
Start agitation at a rotational velocity of 150 rpm for 30 min.
Stop the agitation process.
Remove the aluminum foil covering the beaker.
Take the embedding cassettes out with long forceps.
Place each embedding cassette containing the decellularized skin sample in a 100 mm dish.
Open the cassettes and gently dry the skin samples by dabbing them on laboratory wipes.
Place each decellularized skin sample in a weighing boat previously tagged with the information about the sample.
Cover the weighing boat with aluminum foil and write all the information on top to identify the sample.
Store the sample at -80°C.
